## Description

A euglenoid inside an ellipsoidal lorica (20–42 × 15–26 µm) covered with short spines, brown or orange
from iron and manganese, with 8–10 chloroplasts and a large eyespot. The cell secretes the lorica and
it mineralises with iron (and manganese) precipitating from the water: freshly made it is hyaline and
it darkens in a day or two. At division the daughter leaves through the pore and builds a new lorica.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: `pond` (weight 0.15), `puddle` (weight 0.15); 6 individuals in a reference drop at weight 1.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

An [iron lorica](../../mechanics/metabolism-and-nutrients.md) (`lorica_iron_ratio`, `lorica_hours`): the iron is
taken from the water through `World::exchange` (`Flow::Uptake`) into its own budget compartment, and
the render darkens it with the iron. Spines are covering processes. Iron amount (~20 times the cell
quota) and time estimated.
